name: RPG-7
description_html:
Description

The RPG-7, a very simple yet cost effective solution to anti-infantry and anti-tank problems. Now in player hands.

This mod Requires Arys Asset Importer to fully work

The weapon can be obtained from Prapor at LL1 (barter) and LL3 (money)

Side Note: Warhead model is wrong, that’s the AT version and not HE version (will probably change it when I can find a suitable model, or leave it as is and just imagine it’s a big ass HE warhead). Also haven’t tested the reload because of the ammo size, but it shouldn’t be a problem

you can buy it for a limited amount, cause of course it’s a gun with large area explosion which will delete anyone within maybe 5 or 7 meter radius (could be more, last time i tested with max 70 explosion distance it’s around 100m).

2. Open the Zip

3. Copy the content of the Zip your SPT folder

4. Enjoy
